concerns.text: T014 contains unexpanded template placeholders `{{claim:c_6dd4b25e}}` and `{{claim:c_a6915f96}}` instead of implementing the specific logic for line-noise removal (50/60 Hz notch) and downsampling required by FR-001. This is a semantic weakening of the requirement; the task deliverable will not satisfy the spec if these placeholders remain.

T023 contains an unexpanded template placeholder `{{claim:c_3485d1a1}}` where the specific frequency bands (theta/alpha) should be defined. FR-003 explicitly mandates extraction of 'theta (4–7 Hz) and alpha (8–12 Hz) bands'. Leaving this as a placeholder violates the requirement to implement the specific feature extraction logic.

T035 contains an unexpanded template placeholder `{{claim:c_b784936d}}` instead of specifying the subject-wise splitting algorithm required by FR-005. The task description fails to define the mechanism for creating the 'distinct, non-overlapping held-out test set', rendering the deliverable insufficient to satisfy the functional requirement.

T040 hardcodes a permutation count of '1000' derived from an OEIS sequence reference (A000040). The spec (FR-006/US-3) and plan (Phase 4) do not mandate this specific number; this introduces an arbitrary implementation detail not authorized by the spec. This violates the 'Verified Accuracy' constraint by asserting a specific statistical parameter without a primary-source citation or spec mandate.

T007 is marked as `[ ]` (incomplete) but describes generating `code/data/manifest.yaml` which is required by Constitution Principle VI (Public Dataset Integrity) to record URL, version, and checksums. The task description claims it 'MUST automatically fetch and verify' but the current state (incomplete) and the presence of the task in a 'Foundational' phase that blocks all user stories indicates a critical gap in the plan's execution path for a constitutional requirement.
